blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY, LEYTE, Philippines — Police in Eastern Visayas accounted for 32 firearms and an explosive device in 28 operations conducted across the region on Sept. 28 as part of intensified efforts to curb the possession and proliferation of loose firearms, the Police Regional Office 8 (PRO-8) said.
